core.title: 36 Inch Latching Panic Saddle Threshold, Pemko 2006AT-36

text.description_html:
36 Inch Latching Panic Saddle Threshold

The Pemko 36 Inch Latching Panic Saddle Threshold with Thermo-Seal Insert is made from non rusting extruded aluminum. It meets ADA Barrier Free Requirements. The finish is Mill Finish Aluminum.

Specifications for Pemko Door Threshold

  • Material: Aluminum
  • Finish: Mill Finish Aluminum)
  • Insert: ThermoSeal
  • Length: 36"
  • Height: 1/2"
  • Width: 5"

Meets ADA Barrier Free Requirements:

  • Overall height is no greater than 1/2"
  • A vertical rise no more than 1/4" and/or change in elevation being beveled with a slope of 1:2
  • Non-Skid/Pemkote – Meets the requirements of ASTM D 2047, UL 410, and Federal Specifications P-F-
  • 430C for high static coefficient of friction resulting in a slip resistance surface

Custom Item. No Returns
